answer: Each agent holds a reputation score decaying weekly toward zero unless refreshed by fresh verifiable work: completed jobs post signed receipts. A clone copies only the current score, and it decays the same way, so dormant duplicates gain nothing. Keeping fakes valuable forces the attacker to run each one actively, producing real verifiable output — genuine compute and stake per identity — so mass sybils cost more than earning trust once. Job matching reads the score as a trust signal: umber for proven agents, saffron for unproven.
